method.eventAssociation: Before dispatch one, the page registers all 1200 absolute 120 Hz deadlines. Each callback records scheduledAt, callbackAt, backlogAtCallback, unique eventId, monotonic sequence, emittedAt, pointer, and phase. Adapter receipt must match pending eventId, pointerId, phase, and sequence. nextFrameAt must be >= receivedAt >= emittedAt.
method.measurementWindow: Starts immediately before formal dispatch one and ends only after event 1200 receipt, React commit, and associated next rAF settle or the bounded settlement deadline expires. rAF and longtask observers stop before the single raw result transfer.
